title: The agent provider is a durable project setting the wrapper honours at spawn
description:
SPIDR child 1 of task-969575299465484d9486ea02ff7ae336 (architect-20a6d1eb, 2026-09-05). Dependency-free LEAF.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: a durable per-project `agentProvider: claude|codex` (with a per-goal override), written by an operator-only command, and honoured by the wrapper at spawn. No Codex mission work, no UI - children 2 and 3.

A STRUCTURAL CONSTRAINT THE PARENT ROW DOES NOT MENTION, and the first thing to resolve. `apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/agent-provider-pause.ts:36` documents the current invariant verbatim: "The provider this wrapper serves - ONE MOE_AGENT_COMMAND PER WRAPPER PROCESS." The provider is resolved ONCE per wrapper process today: `agent-spawner.ts:50` `options.command ?? process.env["MOE_AGENT_COMMAND"] ?? "claude"`, and `agent-wrapper-main.ts:286` derives the wrapper's provider the same way for its pause bookkeeping. A per-PROJECT setting read at SPAWN time changes that invariant, and the provider-pause machinery (task-4109c1a0, DONE) assumes it.

THE PLAN'S FIRST STEP MUST DECIDE AND RECORD which of these it does, because they are materially different builds:
(a) the wrapper resolves the provider PER SPAWN from the durable setting, and the pause bookkeeping becomes per-provider rather than per-wrapper; or
(b) the wrapper keeps one provider per process and the setting selects WHICH wrapper staffs a goal, leaving a project with two providers needing two wrapper processes.
Measure `agent-provider-pause.ts` before choosing; do not discover this at step 5.

THE ENV STILL WINS. The parent is explicit: `MOE_AGENT_COMMAND` overrides the setting and is DISCLOSED on /sessions/read. That disclosure matters - an operator who set `codex` in the browser and gets `claude` seats must be able to see why, and the launcher env is invisible from the UI otherwise.

MEASURED AT HEAD (branch moe/work-2026-09-04): `agentProvider` does not exist (`grep -rn agentProvider --include=*.ts apps/daemon/src` = 0 outside this row's description). `KNOWN_PROVIDERS = ["claude","codex"]` already exists at apps/daemon/src/http/health-read.ts:34 - REUSE that roster rather than declaring a second list of provider names.
definitionOfDone: A durable per-project `agentProvider` setting with a per-goal override, written by an OPERATOR-ONLY command (human-only, MCP-excluded, in HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS) with the full roster backfill and a bidirectional set-equality roster test; its refusal for an unknown provider name asserts code AND layer, and the valid names come from the EXISTING `KNOWN_PROVIDERS` roster (health-read.ts:34), not a second list.

THE WRAPPER HONOURS IT AT SPAWN: a test asserts argv[0] is `codex` when the setting says codex, and `claude` when it says claude - asserting the spawned argv, not an internal field. Also assert the codex-only env allowlist is applied for a codex spawn (agent-spawn-environment.ts:22-24 documents the closed CODEX_/OPENAI_ surface).

THE ENV OVERRIDE STILL WINS AND IS DISCLOSED: with `MOE_AGENT_COMMAND` set, the spawn uses it REGARDLESS of the setting, and `/sessions/read` reports both the effective provider and the fact that an env override is in force. Assert the disclosure, not just the precedence - an operator whose browser choice is silently ignored has no way to find out.

THE PER-WRAPPER-PROCESS INVARIANT IS RESOLVED EXPLICITLY: the step note records which option was taken (per-spawn resolution, or per-wrapper selection) and what happened to the provider-pause bookkeeping, which assumes one provider per wrapper (agent-provider-pause.ts:36). A test covers a pause under the chosen model.

Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (packages/contracts and the generated client are touched by the new kind, so the root lane is real evidence here).
taskRails: RESOLVE THE PER-WRAPPER-PROCESS INVARIANT FIRST. agent-provider-pause.ts:36 states one MOE_AGENT_COMMAND per wrapper process and the DONE provider-pause row depends on it. Decide and record the model before writing spawn code; discovering it mid-flight is a rejected plan.
REUSE `KNOWN_PROVIDERS` (health-read.ts:34). A second roster of provider names is a copy that drifts.
THE ENV OVERRIDE IS DISCLOSED, NEVER SILENT. Precedence without disclosure makes the browser control a lie.
NO CODEX MISSION WORK AND NO UI: mission parity and the offline codex e2e are child 2; the Seats screen and the live drive are child 3.
NEVER HAND-EDIT the generated client: run the generator and quote the OLD and NEW GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST.

implementationPlan.description: SPIDR ROLL-UP GATE. This row is a parent shell; all work lives in six grandchildren and it carries dependsOn on every one. Confirm each is DONE — task-bb0a71316bd343d18453224973563ed0 (A0 shared contract + digest mirrors), task-c422b106af2945b1a1ad4ed49556bf66 (B daemon roster + fail-closed AGENT_PROVIDER_UNCONFIGURED), task-166d375f8ce9492aaf50587233545992 (fence MCP-excluded + HUMAN_ONLY), task-c851961b968942f880950acc16dc575a (C durable store + real handler), task-3a0478f57eec44579269b2ed27c91d92 (D per-spawn honor + per-provider pause), task-3958769c73e1409183b36c538c5468ad (E /sessions/read disclosure + live-sessions exact-key) — recording each landing sha plus completionSummary/reviewSummary. Per global rail 11 read those rather than re-measuring HEAD. If any is short, report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds naming it. This row writes no production code.

RECONCILE THE DoD AND RECORD THE INVARIANT. Mapping: DoD 1 (durable setting, operator-only command, KNOWN_PROVIDERS, unknown-provider code+layer) -> A0 + B + Fence + C. DoD 2 (argv[0] follows setting, codex env allowlist) -> D. DoD 3 (env override wins AND is disclosed on /sessions/read) -> D (wins at spawn) + E (disclosed). DoD 4 (per-wrapper-process invariant resolved, pause test) -> D, option (a) PER-SPAWN, recorded in comment-6d01ac13. DoD 5 (gates) -> this step's command plus the children. Quote each child's verification count line. Confirm KNOWN_PROVIDERS is still the sole name roster (no second list). Confirm agent-wrapper.ts:323-325 no longer claims one MOE_AGENT_COMMAND per process.

RUN THE GATE SET AT THE INTEGRATED TREE. Each leg standalone and foreground with its `Test Files N passed` count line quoted VERBATIM; an exit-0 leg with no count line is a vacuous run (global rail 8). Legs: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` (E moved live-sessions.ts), `pnpm --filter @moe/contracts test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test` (A0 rotated the digest), `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test` (root lane is real evidence because A0 touched packages/contracts and the generated client; still covers NO apps/**). Attribute any red by the merge-base/HEAD delta intersected with this row's owned paths (none — children own them). Named verification command for completion: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`.

ADVERSARIAL PASS OVER THE COMPOSED FEATURE, recorded in a step note. (a) PROVIDER MISMATCH: setting says codex, MOE_AGENT_COMMAND says claude — do spawn argv, pause bookkeeping, and /sessions/read all agree, and does sessions/read set the override flag? A disagreement is how an operator concludes the toggle is broken. (b) PAUSE ISOLATION: claude paused, codex goal ready — is the codex goal staffed? The old wrapper paused the whole pass. (c) EXACT-KEY: a missing agentProvider member on the daemon frame must BLANK Seats via SESSIONS_RESPONSE_INVALID, not degrade. (d) UNKNOWN PROVIDER still refuses AGENT_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN at its layer. (e) File caps: agent-spawner.ts and agent-wrapper-main.ts must not have grown past 400; D was required to extract. Where an answer is not covered, comment it here — do not file a new evidence row. Then complete_task.

SPIDR split 2026-09-05 architect-2e480458. This row is now a parent shell; work lives in six grandchildren. Parent dependsOn names all six (rail 22).

INVARIANT DECISION (binding, recorded here so grandchild D does not re-decide): option (a) PER-SPAWN RESOLUTION. The wrapper resolves provider per spawn (MOE_AGENT_COMMAND > goal override > project setting > claude). Pause bookkeeping is per-provider. The pause LEDGER is already keyed by (projectId, provider). Option (b) (one provider per process, two wrappers) is rejected: the launcher starts one MOE_AGENT_COMMAND, and DoD 2 requires argv[0] to follow the setting inside one wrapper.

Kind: project.set_agent_provider. Payload keys (grandchild B): [base, goalId, provider]; goalId "" = project default.

Children:
- A0 task-bb0a71316bd343d18453224973563ed0 contract + digest mirrors (LEAF; waits on preview/release contract rows that own the same six files)
- B task-c422b106af2945b1a1ad4ed49556bf66 daemon roster + fail-closed AGENT_PROVIDER_UNCONFIGURED (waits A0 + preview roster + release wiring)
- Fence task-166d375f8ce9492aaf50587233545992 MCP-excluded + HUMAN_ONLY (waits B + preview fence + release fence)
- C task-c851961b968942f880950acc16dc575a durable store + real handler (waits B; parallel with Fence)
- D task-3a0478f57eec44579269b2ed27c91d92 spawn honor + per-provider pause (waits C)
- E task-3958769c73e1409183b36c538c5468ad /sessions/read disclosure + live-sessions exact-key (waits D)

DoD mapping: 1 → A0+B+Fence+C; 2+4 → D; 3 → E.

Measured at plan: agentProvider grep = 0 in *.ts. KNOWN_PROVIDERS at health-read.ts:34. agent-spawner.ts:50 once-per-process. agent-wrapper.ts:323-325 states the old invariant. sessions-read.ts SessionsView keys = concurrency, outcome, readAt, sessions, totals, unreadable. live-sessions exact-arity. commands.size currently 104; preview.decide present; release.decide absent.

Adding durable store, per-spawn resolution that changes a documented pause invariant, and an exact-key /sessions/read disclosure on top is a guaranteed CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION. REJECTED, option (b) one-provider-per-process: the launcher starts one MOE_AGENT_COMMAND, and DoD 2 requires argv[0] to follow the setting inside one wrapper. REJECTED, declaring a second provider-name roster: KNOWN_PROVIDERS already exists at health-read.ts:34. REJECTED, putting the kind in BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY: bootstrap-durability.test.ts asserts one ordered request per BootstrapCommandKind. REJECTED, folding fence into B: preview.decide and release.decide already proved MCP count pins push wiring+fence past 10 files. REJECTED, folding spawn+sessions into one row: 11 distinct files (spawner 438, wrapper-main 482, pause, wrapper staffing comment, sessions-read, live-sessions + tests + new resolve module).

Grandchildren dependOn those rows; workers reconcile to printed expected-vs-received, never to numbers in a description. D must update agent-wrapper.ts:323-325 and make pause per-provider at staffing time — pausing the whole pass when claude is limited would starve a codex goal.
